newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: PRESS DIGEST - S.Korean newspapers - Jan 29.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - S.Korean newspapers - Jan 29.

text.p: The following is a summary of major South Korean political stories in leading newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Seoul. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy. Telephone: (822) 727-5650. Fax: (822) 727-5666.
- Prosecutors yesterday raided offices of 16 Hanbo Group affiliates and the home of group owner Chung Tai-soo.
- U.S. delivers Message to Taiwan asking to halt shipment of nuclear waste to North Korea.
- A special session of the National Assembly expected to open February 3th for a month.
- Former Hanbo staff in charge of finance and several were summoned and questioned by prosecutors over night.
- Hanbo Iron & Steel and Hanbo Corp filed for court receivership at the Seoul District Court.
